_note: Every quarterback who was his team's main starter (most starts) in at least one season from 2000 on, plus the 2026 starters list. Seasons from 2000 on only. Stats from Pro Football Reference exports for the original 22; the rest use nflverse (starts estimated as the QB with the most pass attempts for his team each week). Contracts from OverTheCap.com. Passing stats only (no rushing). Season awards from Wikipedia and AP voting results; Super Bowl champion counts only the starting QB.
